name: African Proverbs
summary: Communal oral maxims embodying Ubuntu philosophy, ancestral reverence, patience, resilience, and interconnectedness.
bio: African proverbs are the living library of human oral culture, passed down through generations across Akan, Yoruba, Zulu, Swahili, Igbo, and Amharic civilizations. Unlike written texts locked in libraries, African proverbs are dynamic community instruments used by elders, storytellers (griots), and leaders to resolve disputes, impart moral courage, and honor the web of life. At their heart beats the sovereign principle of Ubuntu: 'Umuntu ngumuntu ngabantu' — a person is a person through other persons.

pillars.description: My humanity is inextricably bound up in yours; when one person is diminished, all are diminished.
When the roots of a tree begin to decay, it spreads death to the branches — honor collective foundations.
Smooth seas do not make skillful sailors; character is tested not in ease, but in communal adversity.
Words are like eggs; once dropped, they cannot be gathered back — speaking with reverence and weight.

whyTimeless: African proverbs offer the world an indispensable antidote to hyper-individualism, grounding our lives in community, humility, and ancestral gratitude.
